high energy electrons with energies up to 200 MeV are produced by laser interactions with solid targets and that photonuclear fission is induced by these electrons.
we have observed the first experimental evidence of nuclear fission induced by high energy electrons generated by an ultraintense laser pulse interacting with a solid target.
